org.portico.lrc.services.saverestore.data

Class RestoreManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.lrc.services.saverestore.data.RestoreManager

  • public class RestoreManager
extends Object
    Manages the process of a federation restore, recording the particulars of the save request and lists who has/has not yet completed it. Note that this manager does *NOT* implement the actual restoring the local LRC data, it only manages the flow of calls that dictate when federate move in/out of the various restoration states.

      • requestRestore

        public void requestRestore(int requestingFederate,
                           String label)
                    throws JRestoreInProgress
        This method requests that a new restore be initiated. The label and requesting federate is stored and after this, the statuses for all known federates are set to SRStatus.INITIATED. If there is already an active restore, an exception is thrown.

        NOTE: This will set the pending status to true.

        Throws:
        JRestoreInProgress

      • restoreBegun

        public void restoreBegun()
        Please note that this only applies to the local federate. Notifications that a restore has begun are not broadcast out into the federation, so we only know about the local federate.

      • federateRestoreComplete

        public void federateRestoreComplete(int federate)
                             throws JRestoreNotRequested
        Tell the manager that the federate with the given handle has *successfully* completed the federation restore successfully. Once a notification has been received from all federates, the isRestoreComplete() method will return true. At that point the isRestoreCompleteSuccessful() will return true if all federates restored successfully. If any federates did not complete successfully, that method will return false, indicating that the restore was a failure.
        Throws:
        JRestoreNotRequested

      • federateRestoreNotComplete

        public void federateRestoreNotComplete(int federate)
                                throws JRestoreNotRequested
        Tell the manager that the federate with the given handle has *unsuccessfully* completed the federation restore successfully. Once a notification has been received from all federates, the isRestoreComplete() method will return true. At that point the isRestoreCompleteSuccessful() will return true if all federates restored successfully. If any federates did not complete successfully, that method will return false, indicating that the restore was a failure.
        Throws:
        JRestoreNotRequested

      • isRestoreCompleteSuccessful

        public boolean isRestoreCompleteSuccessful()
        This should only be called after verifying that the entire restore is actually complete (that all federates have responded as such) through the isRestoreComplete() method. If any have not finished, this method will return false which might signal that the restore failed, when really it hasn't finished yet. If all have completed and all have done so successfully, this method will return true.

      • reset

        public void reset()
        This method should be used after a restore has been compelted and the federate notified. It is used to wipe away all information about any existing save and prepare it for a new restore to be initiated.
